description_en: Apartment for sale with an interior area of 125 m2. The apartment is located on "Rrugen e Elbasani", behind the American embassy. It has 3 bedrooms, a living room, 2 bathrooms, a balcony and a kitchen area. It is located on the 7th floor of an 8-story building with an elevator. Solar orientation: East, South, West, allowing natural light in every surface. the apartment. Parking is on the plot of land included in the price. For any information and visits from nearby, contact me
